# Deer meat

Type: Material | Internal ID: DeerMeat | Source: Deer | Usage: Cooking station | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Deer meat is a basic food obtained by killing Deer.
It can be cooked on a Cooking station or Iron cooking station to obtain Cooked deer meat, or Coal if overcooked.

## Availability

• Creature: Deer | 0 Star: 2 | 1 Star: 4 | 2 Star: 8

#### For Deer meat

• Cooked deer meat
• Coal, if left on a Cooking station for too long

#### For Cooked deer meat

• Deer stew
• Whole roasted Meadow boar
Unlike most other foods made from meat, Deer meat has to be cooked on a Cooking station first to be crafted into other foods.

Categorias: Materials, Food
